title: AI Product Factory — Delegation Log
description: Records every required worker invocation during a factory stage. A stage is NOT complete unless all required delegations are recorded here with confirmed artifacts.

factory_version.description: Semantic version of the factory running this log.

project_id.description: The product ID this log belongs to. Null if pre-product stages.

stages.description: Ordered list of stage delegation records.

required_agents.description: List of agent names that MUST be invoked for this stage to be considered complete.

optional_agents.description: Agents that may be invoked if conditions warrant.

invocations.description: Actual recorded invocations for this stage.

stage_status.description: Whether the stage has met its completion criteria.

gate_required.description: Human approval gate label if stage requires one (e.g. 'GATE_1', 'GATE_2', 'GATE_3', 'GATE_4').

gate_approved_at.description: Timestamp when the human approval gate was passed.

completion_notes.description: Free-text summary of stage outcome and any resolved conflicts.

Invocation.description: A single recorded agent invocation event.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for this invocation event (UUID or short slug).

task_description.description: Human-readable description of the task delegated to this agent.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent was invoked.

end_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent returned a result.

result_artifact.description: Relative path to the primary artifact this agent was expected to produce (e.g. 'research/raw/community-signals.md').

artifact_verified.description: Whether the Master confirmed the artifact actually exists and is non-empty after invocation.

failure_reason.description: If invocation_status is 'failed' or 'not_invoked', the reason why.

worker_confidence.description: Confidence score (0-100) reported by the worker agent for its output.

worker_assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions the worker flagged in its output.

worker_risks.description: Risks or uncertainties flagged by the worker.

worker_recommended_next_step.description: The worker's recommended next action after completion.

parallel_group.description: If this agent was invoked as part of a parallel batch, the group label (e.g. 'discovery_parallel_batch_1').
